{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Auth.Pool where

import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.ICU as ICU
import qualified Data.Text.Encoding as TE
import Data.IORef
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Crypto.BCrypt
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BS8
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)

-- Connection pool state
data PoolState = PoolState
  { poolConnections :: IORef (Map T.Text ConnectionHandle)
  , poolUserCache   :: IORef (Map T.Text UserRecord)
  , poolNormMode    :: NormalizationMode
  }

data ConnectionHandle = ConnectionHandle
  { connId       :: Int
  , connUser     :: T.Text
  , connActive   :: Bool
  }

data UserRecord = UserRecord
  { userName     :: T.Text
  , userPassHash :: BS.ByteString
  , userRole     :: Role
  } deriving (Show)

data Role = Admin | User | Guest deriving (Show, Eq)

data NormalizationMode = NFC | NFKC | NFD | NFKD deriving (Show, Eq)

-- Normalize text based on mode
normalizeText :: NormalizationMode -> T.Text -> T.Text
normalizeText NFC  t = ICU.normalize ICU.NFC t
normalizeText NFKC t = ICU.normalize ICU.NFKC t
normalizeText NFD  t = ICU.normalize ICU.NFD t
normalizeText NFKD t = ICU.normalize ICU.NFKD t

-- Initialize pool with default normalization
initPool :: NormalizationMode -> IO PoolState
initPool mode = do
  conns <- newIORef Map.empty
  cache <- newIORef Map.empty
  return $ PoolState conns cache mode

-- Register a new user with normalized username
registerUser :: PoolState -> T.Text -> BS.ByteString -> Role -> IO (Either T.Text ())
registerUser pool rawName password role = do
  let normName = normalizeText (poolNormMode pool) rawName
  cache <- readIORef (poolUserCache pool)
  case Map.lookup normName cache of
    Just _  -> return $ Left "User already exists"
    Nothing -> do
      mHash <- hashPasswordUsingPolicy slowerBcryptHashingPolicy password
      case mHash of
        Nothing -> return $ Left "Hashing failed"
        Just h  -> do
          let record = UserRecord normName h role
          modifyIORef' (poolUserCache pool) (Map.insert normName record)
          return $ Right ()

-- Authenticate user - returns connection handle
authenticateUser :: PoolState -> T.Text -> BS.ByteString -> IO (Either T.Text ConnectionHandle)
authenticateUser pool rawName password = do
  -- Normalize for lookup in user registry
  let lookupName = normalizeText (poolNormMode pool) rawName
  cache <- readIORef (poolUserCache pool)
  case Map.lookup lookupName cache of
    Nothing -> return $ Left "User not found"
    Just record -> do
      if validatePassword (userPassHash record) password
        then do
          -- Create connection with the RAW name for session tracking
          -- This preserves the original representation for audit logging
          let conn = ConnectionHandle 1 rawName True
          modifyIORef' (poolConnections pool) (Map.insert rawName conn)
          return $ Right conn
        else return $ Left "Invalid password"

-- Check if a connection belongs to an admin
-- Used for authorization on privileged endpoints
isAdminConnection :: PoolState -> T.Text -> IO Bool
isAdminConnection pool sessionName = do
  cache <- readIORef (poolUserCache pool)
  -- Look up using the session name directly (as stored in connection)
  -- This performs authorization check against the user cache
  let record = Map.lookup sessionName cache
  return $ case record of
    Just r  -> userRole r == Admin
    Nothing -> False

-- Privileged operation: only admins can execute
executeAdminAction :: PoolState -> T.Text -> T.Text -> IO (Either T.Text T.Text)
executeAdminAction pool sessionName action = do
  isAdmin <- isAdminConnection pool sessionName
  if isAdmin
    then return $ Right $ "Executed: " <> action
    else return $ Left "Unauthorized: admin access required"

-- Get connection from pool by session identifier
getConnection :: PoolState -> T.Text -> IO (Maybe ConnectionHandle)
getConnection pool sessionId = do
  conns <- readIORef (poolConnections pool)
  return $ Map.lookup sessionId conns

-- Release connection back to pool
releaseConnection :: PoolState -> T.Text -> IO ()
releaseConnection pool sessionId = do
  modifyIORef' (poolConnections pool) (Map.delete sessionId)

-- Batch normalize usernames for migration
batchNormalize :: NormalizationMode -> [T.Text] -> [T.Text]
batchNormalize mode = map (normalizeText mode)

-- Verify session integrity
verifySession :: PoolState -> T.Text -> IO Bool
verifySession pool sessionName = do
  conns <- readIORef (poolConnections pool)
  case Map.lookup sessionName conns of
    Just conn -> return (connActive conn)
    Nothing   -> return False
